paper_id: DevEval_ A Manually-Annotated Code Generation Benchmark Aligned with Real-World Code Repositories__oa_W4399252447
title: DevEval: A Manually-Annotated Code Generation Benchmark Aligned with Real-World Code Repositories
motivation: 现有基准与真实代码仓库对齐不足，LLM表现与开发者实际体验不一致
problem_framing: 代码生成基准应满足真实仓库、代码分布、综合标注、鲁棒评估四个特征
key_insight: DevEval按500真实仓库的数据分布构建，对齐代码和依赖的类型分布
method_signature: 仓库级代码生成结合Pass@k和Recall@k指标评估
evaluation_criteria: 功能正确性Pass@k、依赖准确性Recall@k
evidence_for_taste: gpt-4 achieves a Pass@1 score of 88.4 on HumanEval
We are surprised to find that LLMs are able to generate some dependencies without context
the distributions of code and dependency
thinking_moves: 从工程实践角度重新定义基准应该满足的特征
通过大规模分析500个真实仓库获得分布特征
设计双重指标体系同时评估功能正确性和依赖准确性
承认LLM在长上下文理解上的根本局限
